Through the high-altitude drone combat command platform, you cannot participate in combat personally, but you can observe the real-time situation on the battlefield and quickly update your combat deployments via the drone’s camera. However, there is still a time gap and human factors in the issuing and execution of orders. Sometimes, you must anticipate in advance or radically shift your approach. But plans never keep up with changes — perhaps you should be prepared for your operations to be disrupted. Machine gun ammo belts must be assembled from loose rounds in the ammo workshop before they can be used by gunners; ingredients are cooked into hot meals in the field kitchen; the severely wounded undergo emergency surgery before being transported to the rear for treatment; fallen comrades are recovered, prepared, and sent back. You don't just manage a squad of players, you manage a complete organization with four departments that need to work as one gear: Sporting Direction, Medical Department, Marketing, and Financial Department. Each department is made up of staff members with their own attributes, performance, and salary. You decide who to hire, who to fire, and how much you are willing to pay for the talent you need. Matches are won in the office When match day arrives, you have already done your work. You signed the players, hired the coach, and gave him the tools to compete. Now it's your turn to sit down and see if your decisions were the right ones. FD 27's simulation engine reproduces every match minute by minute, with a system that takes into account dozens of variables: the individual quality of each player, their form, their accumulated fatigue level, their morale, the injuries they carry, and the tactical capacity of the coaching staff. You won't see a static match or a simple final result. You will see how your team wears down physically over the ninety minutes, how a player with low morale performs below his level, how an unexpected injury in the 30th minute forces the coach to restructure the team. In FD 27, matches are not won with instructions from the sideline, they are won with the decisions you made weeks, months, and seasons before. Finances, signings, and the art of building without sinking Money is everything and at the same time isn't enough. You can have the biggest budget in the league, but if you manage it poorly, you'll end up in a spiral of debt that will drag the club down for years. FD 27 puts you at the helm of a club's real finances: revenue from television, ticketing, merchandising, and sponsorships against expenses in salaries, signings, infrastructure, and personnel. The transfer market is where great projects are forged and where poorly planned ones die. Every player has a transfer cost and a salary that will impact your accounts throughout the duration of their contract. Signing the star everyone wants can give you an immediate competitive leap, but it can also compromise your ability to strengthen other positions. Would you rather have a star and an unbalanced team, or a well-rounded squad that competes on all fronts? That tension between ambition and sustainability is the heart of the game. Sponsors are another key piece of your financial strategy. As your club grows in reputation and results, new brands will want to associate with you. Each sponsorship contract has its conditions, its duration, and its economic impact. Negotiating well can give you the margin you need to sign that midfielder you're missing. Negotiating poorly can leave you tied to a deal that doesn't reflect the real value of your club. Financial management is not a complement to the game, it is the game. Leagues, players, challenges FD 27 in its version 0.1 includes the leagues of Spain and England. The AI teams compete with each other under the same rules as you: their players get tired, get injured, lose form, and experience good and bad streaks. There are no hidden advantages or shortcuts for the machine. The simulation is fair and symmetrical, which means your victories will be deserved and your defeats will have a real explanation. The game is designed to grow.
